t_advice_summary_textbox.text: They were trying to figure out which colour gnomes have the most points by matching them to the baskets.

vb_textbox.text: I found it difficult myself to work out which gnome and which colour gave out the most points at first. I got into a rhythm working is which gave some of the highest points, especially when the 5x hit. I also found that the biggest 'headed' gnomes tend to give out the higher points on 1x.
